name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Stand Hanging Crystal Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, featuring a 1-layer wooden panel with 5mm thickness for durability and a solid feel.
    - Smoothly cut and polished surface with a warm, wood finish.
    - Includes stainless steel standoff hardware for secure assembly and stable display.
    - Comes with a clear crystal hanging charm, available in round or heart shape, adding an elegant decorative touch.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - 7 x 7 inches ~ 17.78 x 17.78 cm – Square wooden plaque.
    - 3.5 x 7 inches ~ 8.89 x 17.78 cm – Rectangular wooden plaque.
    - Crystal charm sizes:
    Round charm: approx. 3 x 3 cm ~ 1.18 x 1.18 in.
    Heart charm: approx. 3 x 4 cm ~ 1.18 x 1.57 in.
    - Custom-shaped design with pre-drilled holes for hanging charm attachment.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Installation Guide:
    - Insert the metal standoff screw through the pre-drilled hole on the wooden plaque.
    - Secure the back cap tightly to hold the plaque firmly in place.
    - Attach the crystal charm to the front metal hook.
    - Simple installation, no additional tools required.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology.
    - Produces sharp, vibrant, and long-lasting colors.
    - Double-sided printing ensures a polished and visually appealing look from both the front and back.
    - UV ink helps maintain color clarity and prevents fading over time.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a wooden display plaque with a hanging crystal charm for a unique visual effect.
    - The crystal charm gently catches light, creating an elegant accent when displayed.
    - Perfect for placement on desks, shelves, nightstands, memorial tables, or decorative corners.
    - Functions as both a meaningful keepsake and a stylish home décor piece.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and sentimental gift for moms, dads, couples, friends, and family members.
    - Ideal for Mother’s Day, anniversaries, birthdays, memorials, Valentine’s Day, and Christmas.
    - A timeless keepsake that combines wood craftsmanship with delicate decorative charm.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 xCustom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Stand Hanging Crystal Charm

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
